## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Additive only, **or** the PR says "breaking" and lists the affected products and the replacement (renamed/removed token, icon id or logo; changed value or drawing)
- [ ] New tokens are in both `design-tokens.css` and `design-tokens.json`, dark and light, with a contrast pair where they color text or state
- [ ] New icons/logos are listed in `ICONS.md` / `LOGOS.md` and shown in the preview
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets, real people's addresses, real customer data or internal hostnames in the diff
